title: Cherokee Run Golf Club
specs: 18-hole championship golf course designed by Arnold Palmer and Ed Seay
Located within the Georgia International Horse Park in Rockdale County
Proper golf attire required: shirts with collars, golf shorts or slacks; no denim, T-shirts, athletic shorts, swimming trunks, or sweatpants
Check-in 15 minutes prior to tee time
Corporate memberships require minimum three individual memberships for employees

blurb: Cherokee Run Golf Club is an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Arnold Palmer and Ed Seay. They offer golf lessons for all skill levels, weekly golf leagues, and various membership options. The club also hosts business meetings, weddings, receptions, and banquets in a 15,000 square foot clubhouse.
extraNote: Cancellations must be made by calling Pro Shop 24 hours in advance · No-shows charged to credit card with no-show certificates issued · Membership dues charged monthly on first of month with credit card on file · To cancel membership, written notice 30 days in advance required
